instanceof-pattern-binding.title: instanceof pattern binding
instanceof-pattern-binding.short: Test a type and bind the cast value at once
instanceof-pattern-binding.summary: Use an instanceof pattern variable after a successful type test.
instanceof-pattern-binding.why: A pattern variable removes the separate explicit cast and keeps the tested type tied to the value used in the guarded branch.
instanceof-pattern-binding.tips: The pattern variable is available only where control flow proves the match succeeded, so watch its scope in compound conditions.

virtual-threads-basics.title: Virtual thread basics
virtual-threads-basics.short: Run many blocking tasks with lightweight threads
virtual-threads-basics.summary: Use Java 21 virtual threads for highly concurrent blocking work.
virtual-threads-basics.why: Virtual threads make thread-per-task code practical for large numbers of mostly waiting I/O tasks without requiring one OS thread per task.
virtual-threads-basics.tips: They do not make CPU-bound work intrinsically faster. Still bound scarce resources and synchronize shared mutable state correctly.

map-merge-counter.title: Count occurrences with Map.merge
map-merge-counter.short: Combine initialization and increment in one operation
map-merge-counter.summary: Update a per-key counter with Map.merge.
map-merge-counter.why: merge expresses both the value used for a missing key and the function used to combine an existing value in one call.
map-merge-counter.tips: computeIfAbsent is often clearer for creating containers; merge is especially convenient when combining values such as counters.

string-repeat.title: Repeat a string
string-repeat.summary: Repeat the same string a specified number of times.
string-repeat.why: String.repeat directly expresses repetition without a manual loop or repeated StringBuilder append calls.
string-repeat.tips: A negative count throws an exception, and very large counts can produce correspondingly large strings.

runtime-cast-type-mismatch.title: Runtime cast type mismatch
runtime-cast-type-mismatch.short: A value was cast to an incompatible runtime type
runtime-cast-type-mismatch.summary: Check the actual runtime type before casting.
runtime-cast-type-mismatch.why: A cast throws ClassCastException when the runtime type of the referenced object is not compatible with the requested target type.
runtime-cast-type-mismatch.tips: Use instanceof when several runtime types are expected, or redesign the API so the concrete type is preserved statically.

null-unboxing-npe.title: NullPointerException during unboxing
null-unboxing-npe.short: A null wrapper was converted to a primitive
null-unboxing-npe.why: Converting an Integer or another wrapper to its primitive requires reading the wrapped value, so a null reference causes NullPointerException.
null-unboxing-npe.tips: Prefer primitives when absence is not meaningful. If null is allowed, decide the fallback or branch before unboxing.

local-variable-redeclaration-same-scope.title: Local variable redeclared in the same scope
local-variable-redeclaration-same-scope.short: The same local name was declared twice in one scope
local-variable-redeclaration-same-scope.summary: Distinguish declaring a variable from assigning it again.
local-variable-redeclaration-same-scope.why: Java does not allow a second local declaration with the same name in the same scope. Updating an existing variable uses assignment without a type declaration.
local-variable-redeclaration-same-scope.tips: Use distinct names for distinct meanings; use reassignment when the same variable intentionally receives a new value.

incompatible-types-assignment.title: Incompatible types in assignment
incompatible-types-assignment.short: The expression type cannot be assigned to the variable type
incompatible-types-assignment.summary: Make the source and destination types compatible.
incompatible-types-assignment.why: Java is statically typed, so an assignment is rejected when no permitted conversion exists between the expression type and the target type.
incompatible-types-assignment.tips: Use explicit semantic conversions such as parse methods when converting text to numbers rather than relying on a cast.

unchecked-generic-cast.title: Unchecked generic cast warning
unchecked-generic-cast.short: The runtime cannot verify the generic type argument
unchecked-generic-cast.summary: Handle casts that type erasure prevents Java from checking fully.
unchecked-generic-cast.why: The String part of List<String> is not fully available at runtime, so casting an arbitrary value to that parameterized type cannot prove element type safety.
unchecked-generic-cast.tips: Prefer a generic source API. Otherwise receive List<?> and validate elements individually instead of suppressing the warning broadly.

equals-with-double.title: Do not assume floating-point results are exact
equals-with-double.short: Exact == comparison fails after floating-point arithmetic
equals-with-double.summary: Compare floating-point calculations with their rounding behavior in mind.
equals-with-double.why: Many decimal fractions have no exact binary floating-point representation, so arithmetic can round to a nearby value rather than the expected exact decimal.
equals-with-double.tips: Use a tolerance appropriate to the domain. For exact decimal quantities such as money, consider BigDecimal.
